title: Get the details of a TTO Creator Marketplace account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the details of a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace account. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/oauth2/info/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by a TTO Creator Marketplace account.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |tto_tcm_account_id {Required}|string|The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

To obtain the IDs of the accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146).| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/oauth2/info/?tto_tcm_account_id={{tto_tcm_account_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| tto_tcm_account_id | string | The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.| #| account_name | string | The name of the TTO Creator Marketplace account. | #| timezone | string | The time zone code of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

Example: `America/Los_Angeles`.

To find out the time zone that a time zone code corresponds to, see [Time zone](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737586324313089). | #| country | string | The country or region code of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

Example: `US`.

To find out the country or region that a country or region code corresponds to, see [Location code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737585867307010). | #| business_verification_status | string | The business verification status of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

Enum values:
  • `NOT_SUBMITTED`: The account has not been submitted for business verification review.
  • `UNDER_REVIEW`: The account is under business verification review.
  • `NOT_PASSED`: The account has failed the business verification review.
  • `PASSED`: The account has passed the business verification review.
  • `EXPIRED`: The business verification for the account has expired.

Learn more about [Business Verification on TikTok One](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/how-to-verify-your-business-for-tiktok-one). | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "account_name": "{{account_name}}", "business_verification_status": "PASSED", "country": "US", "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles", "tto_tcm_account_id": "{{tto_tcm_account_id}}" } } (/code) ```
